bio_en: Ruben Darbinian was born in Akhalkalaki and educated in Russian schools in Ekaterinodar and Tiflis, then at the universities of Moscow and Heidelberg, defending a doctoral thesis in social sciences in 1909. Active in journalism from 1902-03, he joined the ARF in 1906 and came to know Rostom and leaders such as Zavarian, Aharonian and Varandian. To avoid arrest he left, under the alias Artashes Chilingarian, for Constantinople and in 1910 for Germany. He later held high office in the Republic of Armenia and, in exile, was a leading ARF editor; he died on 14 June 1968.
